title: Reactivating a rep does not put them back on their customers
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create three active staff members for this test at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A, sales rep B and sales rep C.
  • Create customer A for this test, whose one Sales Representative is sales rep C.
  • Create customer B for this test, with "Sales Representative - Service Labor" set to sales rep A, "Sales Representative - Service Parts" set to sales rep B and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" set to sales rep C.
  • Then deactivate sales rep C's staff account.
  • Open sales rep C's staff record in Settings > Staff in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Reactivate sales rep C's account.
  2. Open customer A's page.
  3. Open customer B's page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales rep C's account is active again.

Step 2:

  • Customer A's "Sales Representative" reads "Unassigned".
  • Sales rep C has not been put back.

Step 3:

  • Customer B shows "Sales Representative - Service Labor" sales rep A and "Sales Representative - Service Parts" sales rep B.
  • There is no Part Sales field.
  • Sales rep C has not been put back.

The Sales By Representative spec, version 28 (12 Oct 2026, Story 13), says reactivating brings a person back to their customers. Chris Ward ruled on 19 Oct 2026 that they are not put back (answer 12, quoted below); this case follows PRD version 10.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R20: “Deactivating a staff member's account removes them from every customer field they hold. The customer's other fields keep their people. A Part Sales field where they were picked is removed, so new part sales follow again (S4-R26). Reactivating the account does not put them back.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 12: “12. (a) as the feature spec: removed from every customer field they hold, not put back on reactivation. New warning line: "They will be removed as sales representative from {n} customers."”
